en: A black and white photograph depicting a small rural village street scene. Several wooden houses, typical of early 20th-century Northern Europe, are visible. There are trees and a dirt road with some large barrels or logs lying near the center. A few people, including children, are standing along the road. There is visible text in the lower left corner that reads 'Foldal.'
